sources.title: Vansh180/deepfake-audio-wav2vec2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model is built on top of facebook/wav2vec2-base, a self-supervised speech representation model, and adapted for binary deepfake audio detection. It learns subtle acoustic artifacts and synthetic speech patterns that differentiate genuine human recordings from AI-generated or manipulated audio samples.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning Wav2Vec2 for Real-Time Deepfake Audio Detection
sources.snippet: This project demonstrates fine-tuning and deploying a Wav2Vec2 model for real-time deepfake audio detection. sources.title: [2507.01750] Generalizable Detection of Audio Deepfakes
